step.en: Report tab 'RIP' appears on the staff portal Report page only for users with the REPORT_RIP function
step.id: Tab 'RIP' muncul di halaman Report staff portal hanya untuk user yang punya function REPORT_RIP

detail.en: The TabItem is wrapped in hasFunction(FUNCTION_ID.REPORT_RIP) and FUNCTION_ID.REPORT_RIP = 'OCMS_REPORT_RIP' (ocmsadminui/src/utils/constant.ts:254). The server also maps OCMS_REPORT_RIP to /v1/reports/rip in api-authorization.properties:123-124. Whether a user really holds the function depends on role data in the DB (cannot verify from repo).
detail.id: TabItem dibungkus hasFunction(FUNCTION_ID.REPORT_RIP) dan FUNCTION_ID.REPORT_RIP = 'OCMS_REPORT_RIP' (ocmsadminui/src/utils/constant.ts:254). Di server, OCMS_REPORT_RIP juga dipetakan ke /v1/reports/rip di api-authorization.properties:123-124. Apakah user benar-benar punya function itu tergantung data role di DB (cannot verify from repo).

step.en: Screen search calls POST /v1/reports/rip/furnished-driver-hirer and lists PS-RP2 notices whose current offender is a deceased hirer or driver
step.id: Search di layar memanggil POST /v1/reports/rip/furnished-driver-hirer dan menampilkan notice PS-RP2 yang offender-nya hirer atau driver yang sudah meninggal

detail.en: ReportListRIP.tsx:74 uses resource 'reports/rip/furnished-driver-hirer' with method POST; the controller filters by date of suspension. RipReportServiceImpl.java:305-310 keeps only records where offender indicator is Y, owner_driver_indicator is H or D and life_status is D (deceased), so the 'furnished hirer or driver' wording in the story really means 'deceased hirer/driver'.
detail.id: ReportListRIP.tsx:74 memakai resource 'reports/rip/furnished-driver-hirer' dengan method POST; controller memfilter berdasarkan date of suspension. RipReportServiceImpl.java:305-310 hanya meloloskan record dengan offender indicator Y, owner_driver_indicator H atau D, dan life_status D (meninggal), jadi kata 'furnished hirer or driver' di story sebenarnya berarti hirer/driver yang sudah meninggal.

step.en: Excel download from the screen calls POST /v1/reports/rip/export
step.id: Download Excel dari layar memanggil POST /v1/reports/rip/export

detail.en: ReportListRIP.tsx:50-63 posts to 'reports/rip/export' with the same filters and saves the returned Blob as RIP_Hirer_Driver_Furnished_Report.xlsx; the controller builds the .xlsx in generateRipFurnishedReportExcel and returns it as an attachment. This screen file name is different from the daily job file name in the next steps.
detail.id: ReportListRIP.tsx:50-63 melakukan POST ke 'reports/rip/export' dengan filter yang sama lalu menyimpan Blob hasilnya sebagai RIP_Hirer_Driver_Furnished_Report.xlsx; controller membuat .xlsx lewat generateRipFurnishedReportExcel dan mengembalikannya sebagai attachment. Nama file di layar ini berbeda dari nama file daily job di step berikutnya.

step.en: Daily job selects notices suspended under PS-RP2 with a hirer/driver offender and builds 'OCMS_RIP_Hirer_Driver_Report_<date>.xlsx' with a Summary sheet and a data sheet
step.id: Daily job memilih notice yang disuspend PS-RP2 dengan offender hirer/driver dan membuat 'OCMS_RIP_Hirer_Driver_Report_<date>.xlsx' dengan sheet Summary dan sheet data

detail.en: The native query joins ocms_suspended_notice with owner_driver where offender_indicator='Y', owner_driver_indicator IN ('H','D'), life_status='D', suspension_type='PS', reason 'RP2', date_of_revival IS NULL and date_of_suspension = the report date. RipHirerDriverReportHelper.java:110-113 creates sheets 'Summary' and 'RIP_Hirer_Driver_Furnished'; RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:101 builds the file name. The report date defaults to today, so the 08:00 run only lists notices suspended on that same day (earlier than 08:00); this is how the code works, not a defect we can prove. Review: the daily file is only built, not delivered with the repo config, and the selection is deceased (life_status D) with a same-day suspension, which the step text under-describes (OcmsSuspendedNoticeRepository.java:50-70).
detail.id: Native query menggabungkan ocms_suspended_notice dengan owner_driver dengan syarat offender_indicator='Y', owner_driver_indicator IN ('H','D'), life_status='D', suspension_type='PS', reason 'RP2', date_of_revival IS NULL dan date_of_suspension = report date. RipHirerDriverReportHelper.java:110-113 membuat sheet 'Summary' dan 'RIP_Hirer_Driver_Furnished'; RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:101 membentuk nama file. Report date default-nya hari ini, jadi run jam 08:00 hanya memuat notice yang disuspend di hari yang sama (sebelum jam 08:00); itu cara code bekerja, bukan defect yang bisa dibuktikan. Review: file harian hanya dibuat, tidak terkirim dengan config repo, dan seleksinya adalah yang meninggal (life_status D) dengan suspension hari yang sama, yang kurang tergambar di teks step (OcmsSuspendedNoticeRepository.java:50-70).

step.en: The file is e-mailed to the recipients in email.report.recipients; a 'no data' mail and a failure mail are also sent
step.id: File dikirim lewat e-mail ke penerima di email.report.recipients; ada juga e-mail 'no data' dan e-mail gagal

detail.en: The job code does build the three mails (attachment mail, '(No Data)' mail at line 84, 'FAILED' mail). But email.enableSmtp=false in application-prod.properties:80 (and application-uat.properties:78), and EmailService.java:65-70 returns false when SMTP is disabled and the request source is not in email.smtp.allowedSources. The RIP job never sets a source and the allowlist (application-prod.properties:81) does not contain it, so with the repo config none of the three mails is sent; the job even returns failed at line 126. The real server value cannot be verified from the repo. The failure mail uses the same property email.report.recipients (job lines 35 and 38), not a separate support list.
detail.id: Code job memang membuat tiga e-mail (e-mail attachment, e-mail '(No Data)' di line 84, e-mail 'FAILED'). Tapi email.enableSmtp=false di application-prod.properties:80 (dan application-uat.properties:78), dan EmailService.java:65-70 mengembalikan false kalau SMTP mati dan source request tidak ada di email.smtp.allowedSources. Job RIP tidak pernah mengisi source dan allowlist (application-prod.properties:81) tidak memuatnya, jadi dengan config di repo ketiga e-mail tidak terkirim; job bahkan return gagal di line 126. Nilai asli di server cannot be verified from repo. E-mail gagal memakai property yang sama, email.report.recipients (job line 35 dan 38), bukan daftar support terpisah.

step.en: The job runs inside the Combined Daily Report at 08:00 (cron.dailyreport.enabled=true)
step.id: Job berjalan di dalam Combined Daily Report jam 08:00 (cron.dailyreport.enabled=true)

detail.en: executeDailyReportJobs runs the RIP job as job3 (line 98). cron-schedules-prod.properties:255-256 has schedule '0 0 8 * * ?' and enabled=true. The Javadoc of RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:25 still says 'Daily at 02:00 AM'; that is a stale comment, the properties file wins. Real server value cannot be verified from the repo.
detail.id: executeDailyReportJobs menjalankan job RIP sebagai job3 (line 98). cron-schedules-prod.properties:255-256 berisi schedule '0 0 8 * * ?' dan enabled=true. Javadoc RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:25 masih menulis 'Daily at 02:00 AM'; itu komentar lama, yang berlaku properties file. Nilai asli di server cannot be verified from repo.

note.en: Evidence is 4 Sesuai + 2 Sebagian of 6 steps (83.3 percent). The report exists end to end (tab, screen search, Excel export, daily job, scheduler), but the e-mail leg is switched off by email.enableSmtp=false in the prod and UAT properties and the RIP job has no allowlisted source, so the repo cannot prove that any RIP mail reaches the OIC. No URA deck or workbook sheet for this report is in the repo; ticket OCMS-DF-2026-149 only mentions Report module Excel exports in general. Whether this belongs to the OCMS14.x RIP flow is a commercial question the repo cannot answer. [Medium confidence] From reading the code (not run): RipHirerDriverReportJob is a singleton @Component; reportDate is only set when null (RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:268-272), cleanup() does not reset it (line 296) and DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:98 calls execute() without a date, so repeated scheduled runs in the same running instance may reuse the first date until restart. Verify in UAT with two consecutive days.
note.id: Evidence 4 Sesuai + 2 Sebagian dari 6 step (83,3 persen). Report-nya ada dari ujung ke ujung (tab, search di layar, export Excel, daily job, scheduler), tapi jalur e-mail dimatikan oleh email.enableSmtp=false di properties prod dan UAT dan job RIP tidak punya source yang masuk allowlist, jadi repo tidak bisa membuktikan ada e-mail RIP yang sampai ke OIC. Tidak ada deck atau sheet workbook URA untuk report ini di repo; ticket OCMS-DF-2026-149 hanya menyebut export Excel modul Report secara umum. Apakah ini masuk flow RIP OCMS14.x adalah soal komersial yang tidak bisa dijawab repo. [Medium confidence] Dari membaca code (tidak dijalankan): RipHirerDriverReportJob adalah singleton @Component; reportDate hanya diisi kalau null (RipHirerDriverReportJob.java:268-272), cleanup() tidak me-reset-nya (line 296) dan DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:98 memanggil execute() tanpa tanggal, jadi run terjadwal berulang di instance yang sama mungkin memakai ulang tanggal pertama sampai restart. Verifikasi di UAT dengan dua hari berturut-turut.

corrections: Acceptance 'The file is e-mailed to the recipients in email.report.recipients; a no data mail and a failure mail are also sent' is too strong: email.enableSmtp=false in application-prod.properties:80 and application-uat.properties:78, and the RIP job sets no source, so EmailService blocks the mails with the repo config.
Acceptance 'Excel file OCMS_RIP_Hirer_Driver_Report_<date>.xlsx' applies to the daily job only; the screen export downloads RIP_Hirer_Driver_Furnished_Report.xlsx.
Story wording 'furnished hirer or driver' should say deceased (life_status D) hirer/driver offender; the query and service both require it.
Demo step 'In UAT check the OIC mailbox at 08:00' will show nothing with the repo UAT config (email.enableSmtp=false, application-uat.properties:78).
The Javadoc of RipHirerDriverReportJob says 02:00 but the schedule is 08:00 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:255); do not quote the Javadoc.
